annotation.authors_or_issuer: Artificial Intelligence Board (AIB) and Medical Device Coordination Group (MDCG)
key_provisions_or_claims: MDR/IVDR and AI Act apply simultaneously and complementarily to medical devices containing high-risk AI systems.
An AI medical device is high-risk under Art. 6(1) if it is a safety component or product subject to notified-body conformity assessment under MDR/IVDR.
Providers may integrate AI Act QMS, risk management, documentation and post-market monitoring into existing MDR/IVDR processes (Art. 8(2)).
Pre-determined changes assessed at initial conformity assessment are not a substantial modification; Annex I obligations apply from 2 August 2027.
Human oversight must be commensurate with risk and autonomy; highly autonomous surgical devices should not permit harmful human intervention.
annotation.summary_en: Joint AI Board and MDCG FAQ guidance (June 2025) on how the EU Medical Devices Regulation and IVDR interact with the AI Act for AI-enabled medical devices. It covers high-risk classification, QMS, data governance, human oversight, conformity assessment, substantial modification and post-market monitoring, encouraging integrated compliance procedures. Non-binding.
annotation.title_clean: Interplay between the Medical Devices Regulation (MDR) & In vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation (IVDR) and the Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA)
